page.layout: One printed page: running head and page number at top; heading "JUSTI LIPSII ALLOCUTIO." centred; one column of text below with a historiated initial; catchword/signature line at foot.

main_text.head: ALLOCUTIO.
main_text.p: AD textum etiam meum, Lector, visum fuit breviter hæc notare. Cur non in ipso? quia non pro omnium gustu hæc talia, & plerisque satis est capita rerum delibasse. Caussa etiam, quia placuit quædam explicatiùs aut firmiùs iterare. Debui sanè, ut hoc ævum est : in quo calumniæ, ut ille inquit. Quasi herba irrigua, succrescunt uberrimè.

page.notes: The initial "A" is a woodcut historiated letter, read as A with [?] for its ornamented form. The word "succrescunt" is printed as "fuccre-runt" across a line end; read as succrescunt. Catchword "In" at lower right.
